blocks.html: Robinsons Homes: Building enduring addresses to last for generations

The ideal home of every Filipino family is nestled in a thriving community that marries serene living with urban conveniences. They aspire of owning a sanctuary that integrates lush landscapes to an expansive selection of lifestyle amenities. They only entrust this dream to a reliable developer known to build addresses that stand the test of time.
Building trust and loyalty for 20 years

“Robinsons Homes is one of the leading real estate brands in the country with more than 10,000 households nurtured and contentedly part of the growing Robinsons addresses nationwide,” said Robinsons Homes General Manager Cora Ang Ley.

With 20 years of real estate experience, Robinsons Homes has established a solid track record of building master-planned subdivisions. From its first residential subdivision built in Antipolo, the brand now showcases over 32 master planned enclaves nationwide.
Robinsons Homes offers a complete portfolio of horizontal projects that cater to start-up to growing families aspiring to own their first home or upgrade to a better neighborhood. Its products are currently managed under three sub-brands: the premium Bloomfields, the mid-level Brighton, and the affordable Springdale.
“Each project built under these sub-brands will feature a distinct architectural concept that is rich in character,” Ang Ley said. “These will highlight Robinsons Homes’ value-for-money proposition and differs on location, house and lot sizes, and types of amenities.”
Unveiling beautiful homes for generations

Epitomizing Robinsons Homes’ development philosophy of building pamana developments of quality and enduring value, the brand recently unveiled a beautiful line of House Design Collections named after each sub brand —The Bloomfields Collection, The Brighton Collection, and The Springdale Collection.
“We drew inspiration from the aspirations and the lifestyle choices of our Robinsons Homes families in coming up with this extensive House Design Collection. The market is evolving and we wanted to grow with them by catering to their needs the best way we can,” stated Ang Ley.
Inspiring Modern Suburban Living Standards
Each Collection will carry 5 design options. Featuring contemporary facades rich in style and character, these house designs are set to create a benchmark of modern suburban living as well as new dimensions of prestige, comfort and practicality.
"We were mindful of the layouts and the materials for the House Design Collection,” adds Ang Ley. “Some of these homes were designed to house three generations with generous living areas that are well-defined - bigger bedrooms, additional bathrooms and more spaces for family interaction and bonding. Each home design is also complemented by quality fixtures and finishing.”
The Bloomfields Collection: Live grand. Live in full bloom.
The Bloomfields Collection features sprawling home designs reminiscent of contemporary Balinese Villas. Characterized by earth-tone hues and eco-friendly features that include large glass-paneled windows that allow natural lighting and ventilation, these 2-storey house designs also offers a high-ceiling living room and a spacious dining room that extends to a scenic garden terrace via glass sliding doors, and an open kitchen design complete with island tables, as well as overhead cabinets and under cabinets for easy storage.
These designs consist of 4 bedrooms, including a master bedroom with private bathrooms and walk-in wardrobes, 4-5 toilet and baths, a den which can be converted to a home office or library, balconies with an excellent vantage point for enjoying panoramic views of the enclave, as well as carports big enough to accommodate 2 cars.
Designed for families who live large and grand, these Asian tropical-inspired home designs have floor areas that start at 300sqm. with prices that start at Php 8.8 million. The 5 designs were named after beautiful iconic women – Eleonor, Elizabeth, Hilary, Marilyn, and Audrey. These designs will be made exclusively available to buyers of Bloomfields developments.
The Brighton Collection: Brighter days ahead
The Brighton Collection showcases home designs inspired by Contemporary Mediterranean architecture. With distinct warm hues, these 2-storey houses integrates comfort and style.
"We've designed these homes to accommodate stylish balconies and open dining and kitchen spaces so that families who live here can expand their personal space during special occasions," explains Ang Ley.

These designs consist of 3 bedrooms, including a master bedroom with private bathrooms and walk-in closets, 4 toilet and baths, a family hall, a balcony and 2-vehicle carports.
Designed for growing families, this collection will have floor areas that start at 200 sqm. in size. with prices that start at Php5 million. The 5 designs are named Francisco, Stefano, Veria, Marsala and Palermo. These designs will be made exclusively available to buyers of Brighton developments.
The Springdale Collection: The Perfect Choice of Young Families.
Perfect for starting families aspiring for a better life, The Springdale Collection modern yet practical house designs. "This Collection caters to the needs of everyday living – every day essentials without compromising what you value the most," offers Ang Ley.
These 2-storey home designs feature a contemporary minimalist architecture with 3 bedrooms, including a master bedroom with private bathrooms and walk-in closets, 3 toilet and baths, a balcony and single carport.
This collection will have floor areas that start at 150 sqm. in size. with prices that start at Php4 million. Designed for families who want to invest in their first home and spring to a new life, the 5 designs were named after leaves to represent growth – Spruce, Cedar, oak, Maple, and Walnut. These designs will be made exclusively available to buyers of Springdale developments.
The debut of contemporary homes
Robinsons Homes assures the homeowners that they have freedom to either design their own homes according to their personal tastes or choose from our set of themed and master-planned house collections.
“Whether you’re a starting, growing, or extended family, Robinsons Homes can offer varying home designs to suit your needs and aspirations,” shared Ang Ley. Living in a Robinsons Homes development is a step forward for your family to experience living the good life that can last for generations to come.
